activities.description: Darhan Regional Health Initiative (DRHI). Spearheaded a student-led initiative to address healthcare disparities in the Darhan region. Organized monthly health education workshops for 50+ community members, focusing on preventative care and hygiene. Secured $500 in funding through local businesses, which helped procure essential medical supplies for underserved families.

activities.description: Mongolia Math and Science Academy (MMSA) Tutoring Program. Mentored 15+ underprivileged middle school students in mathematics and science, improving their grades by an average of 15%. Developed customized learning plans based on student needs. Organized weekly study sessions, fostering a collaborative learning environment and boosting student confidence.

activities.description: "Steppe to Success" College Access Program. Guided 10+ first-generation, low-income Mongolian students through the complex college application process. Conducted workshops on essay writing, financial aid, and interview skills. Leveraged personal experiences to provide mentorship and support, resulting in 80% of participants gaining college admission.
